Who is the Current Prime Minister of Bangladesh?

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

A. Sheikh Hasina Wajid
B. Khalida Zia
C. Tarique Rahman

Advertisement

Tarique Rahman assumed office on 17 February 2026, after his Bangladesh Nationalist Party won the 2026 general election.

Track Exec Orders

The correct answer to the question: "Who is the Current Prime Minister of Bangladesh?" is "Tarique Rahman".
